name: Service Agreement
description: Risk checklist for client service agreements, consulting contracts, and SOWs.

categories.name: Payment terms
categories.description: Flag payment windows longer than 30 days, no deposit requirement, payment gated on vague acceptance, no late fees, or payment tied to conditions the provider cannot control.

categories.name: Scope and revisions
categories.description: Flag vague scope, unlimited revisions, no change-order process, or deliverables without measurable acceptance criteria.

categories.name: IP and ownership
categories.description: Flag assignment of pre-existing tools, IP transfer before full payment, no portfolio rights, or overly broad IP assignment beyond the project scope.

categories.name: Liability and indemnification
categories.description: Flag uncapped liability, broad indemnification covering the client's negligence, overbroad warranties, or liability disproportionate to fees.

categories.name: Termination
categories.description: Flag no kill fee, short notice periods, asymmetric cancellation rights, or no provision for payment on work completed before termination.

categories.name: Non-compete and exclusivity
categories.description: Flag non-compete or exclusivity clauses that prevent working with other clients in the same industry.

categories.name: Confidentiality
categories.description: Flag one-sided confidentiality, excessively long periods, or overly broad definitions of confidential information.

categories.name: Work-for-hire
categories.description: Flag work-for-hire designations that strip all reuse rights for code, designs, or templates used across clients.
